# 23. Extraordinary material archetypes

These are design templates, not universal fantasy substances.

### XMAT-L — Lightweight structural material

Typical purpose:

reduce mass/burden while retaining approximately equivalent protective behavior.

Possible setting calibration:

`Mass ×0.5–0.75`

Do not automatically increase Resistance.

---

### XMAT-H — Extreme hard/tough material

Possible behavior:

- +1 relevant Resistance;
- +1 Structure;
- +1 Armor Defeat for suitable edges.

Such benefits require:

- appropriate construction;
- difficult workability;
- rarity or production constraints.

Do not apply all three automatically.

---

### XMAT-C — Supernatural conductor

Mechanical purpose:

- channels magical effects;
- supports enchantment;
- stores or transmits supernatural resources.

It need not be physically stronger than steel.

---

### XMAT-I — Supernatural insulator

Mechanical purpose:

provide Resistance against one or more supernatural channels.

It may be physically poor armor.

---

### XMAT-R — Regenerative/living material

Mechanical purpose:

recover Local Stress or Condition through defined biological/supernatural processes.

It still requires:

- time;
- nutrients or magical resources;
- survival of the relevant material.

---

# PART IX — CREATURE CONSTRUCTION

## 51. PAR-PSI — Psionic/Mental Capability

### Source

Mind, nervous system, psychic field, or setting-defined equivalent.

### Access

Innate and/or trained.

### Typical resource

- concentration;
- strain;
- internal reserve;
- fatigue.

### Typical channels

- Mental;
- Spiritual;
- physical only where explicitly converted.

### Core restrictions

Telepathy accesses:

**information present in the target or channel**

not objective world truth.

Mind reading does not reveal facts the target does not know.

Precognition must define exactly what kind of information it provides.

---

# PART XVIII — INTERNAL ENERGY TEMPLATE

payload.Source section:
## 53. PAR-BLD — Blood/Sacrificial Magic

### Source

Life, blood, tissue, sacrifice, or equivalent metaphysical principle.

### Cost provenance

Every sacrifice must come from an actual:

- actor;
- stored material;
- ritual resource.

The source loses what was spent.

### Anti-exploit rule

If magical healing can immediately restore sacrificed tissue/blood, the setting must explicitly decide whether this also restores the magical value sacrificed.

Otherwise:

> sacrifice → spell → healing → sacrifice

creates infinite power.

The default is:

**restoring physical tissue does not automatically restore already-expended supernatural sacrificial value.**

---

# PART XX — RUNIC/ENCHANTMENT TEMPLATE

- rarity or production constraints.

Do not apply all three automatically.

---

### XMAT-C — Supernatural conductor

Mechanical purpose:

- channels magical effects;
- supports enchantment;
- stores or transmits supernatural resources.

It need not be physically stronger than steel.

---

### XMAT-I — Supernatural insulator

Mechanical purpose:

provide Resistance against one or more supernatural channels.

It may be physically poor armor.

---

### XMAT-R — Regenerative/living material

Mechanical purpose:

recover Local Stress or Condition through defined biological/supernatural processes.

It still requires:

- time;
- nutrients or magical resources;
- survival of the relevant material.

## 51. PAR-PSI — Psionic/Mental Capability

### Source

Mind, nervous system, psychic field, or setting-defined equivalent.

### Access

Innate and/or trained.

### Typical resource

- concentration;
- strain;
- internal reserve;
- fatigue.

### Typical channels

- Mental;
- Spiritual;
- physical only where explicitly converted.

### Core restrictions

Telepathy accesses:

**information present in the target or channel**

not objective world truth.

Mind reading does not reveal facts the target does not know.

Precognition must define exactly what kind of information it provides.

## 53. PAR-BLD — Blood/Sacrificial Magic

### Source

Life, blood, tissue, sacrifice, or equivalent metaphysical principle.

### Cost provenance

Every sacrifice must come from an actual:

- actor;
- stored material;
- ritual resource.

The source loses what was spent.

### Anti-exploit rule

If magical healing can immediately restore sacrificed tissue/blood, the setting must explicitly decide whether this also restores the magical value sacrificed.

Otherwise:

> sacrifice → spell → healing → sacrifice

creates infinite power.

The default is:

**restoring physical tissue does not automatically restore already-expended supernatural sacrificial value.**

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Enchanted equipment facet
new_proposed_archetypes.function: A physically existing item with a persistent extraordinary function
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Substrate, compatible inscription/binding, energy/source, crafting project, activation rule, maintenance and countermeasure
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: An item broken beyond function does not remain operational unless independent anchoring is specified

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Bound focus or reservoir
new_proposed_archetypes.function: A focus channels or stores a bounded supernatural resource
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Resource species, initial charge lot/pool, capacity, allowed users, input/output, leakage/recharge model
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: Possessing focus does not give expertise; charging is not free

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Potion or infused consumable
new_proposed_archetypes.function: A consumable delivers an effect upon qualified use
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Formula, dosage, contents, potency model, ingestion/contact path, shelf life, side effects, effect channel
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: One consumed dose cannot also remain as inventory

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Ward or boundary field
new_proposed_archetypes.function: A constrained area/object protection against named channels
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Anchor/location, source/upkeep, protection target, coverage, limits, detection, bypass/maintenance
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: Protection applies once and is not universal invulnerability

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Portal / teleportation link
new_proposed_archetypes.function: Actual identified actors/assets can move through an extraordinary link
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Endpoint geometry, direction, payload/mass capacity, energy/time, authorization, transit state, abort/failure
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: Opening portal does not spawn arriving cargo or reset supplies

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Summoned autonomous ally
new_proposed_archetypes.function: An actually identified autonomous actor may be transported or instantiated by setting mechanism
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Origin/identity, consent/control terms, arrival, duration, upkeep, return, communication
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: Summoning is not a free extra attack or automatic obedience

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Conjured commodity
new_proposed_archetypes.function: An explicit supernatural transformation yields usable matter/food/water
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Source/cost, product spec, quantity, acceptance, permanence and degradation
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: Forecast quantity and effect description are not actual new stock until successful creation

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Dragonlike organism variant
new_proposed_archetypes.function: A winged, massive or otherwise dragonlike organism with bespoke biological and supernatural capability
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Actual anatomy, flight mass and environment, breath delivery, ecology, needs, intelligence and prey
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: No free flight, breath, immunity or boss actions from the name

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Undead animated body
new_proposed_archetypes.function: A corpse may move under setting-defined animation without reinstating its old person
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Corpse provenance/location/condition, animation source, control, upkeep, sensory/motion means
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: Animation does not restore original soul, rights, memories or healing by default

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Elemental / manifest spirit
new_proposed_archetypes.function: An explicitly enabled extraordinary entity interacting with material state
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Substrate, identity, agency, location, duration, limits, environmental needs and harm channels
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: Elemental does not mean immunity to all mundane causes

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Shapeshifter / cursed form
new_proposed_archetypes.function: An existing actor's actual body configuration can change within a bounded mechanism
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Trigger, anatomy, mass, inventory interaction, cognition, duration, reversibility, injuries
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: No duplication of body/gear; existing injuries persist unless explicitly changed

new_proposed_archetypes.name: Construct or golem
new_proposed_archetypes.function: Manufactured frame with specified independent or delegated tasks
new_proposed_archetypes.requirements: Power, sensors, autonomy, control authority, means, maintenance, damage map and shutdown
new_proposed_archetypes.limitations: No universal mental immunity; cannot execute commands beyond capability
